title: Team Protocols
description: Root wraps mailbox traffic in typed envelopes and matches N in-flight requests by replyTo. Codex stamps NEW_TASK / MESSAGE / FINAL_ANSWER; the ledger is a teaching extra.

steps.content: Document the agent loop in three sections. Broadcast kickoff, then assign alice and bob — match their replies by id.
steps.annotation: s15 mail is still one sentence. Three results flowing back need a correlation key.

steps.content: broadcast root → alice, bob [bcast_001] kickoff: we are documenting the agent loop today
steps.annotation: broadcast is a teaching extra (Codex has no everyone-announcement kind). No reply expected.

steps.content: request root → alice [req_002] triggerTurn=true  Write the 'agent loop' overview section
steps.annotation: request ≈ Codex NEW_TASK / followup: queue and wake the child to work. Root records req_002 in the pending ledger.

steps.content: request root → bob [req_003]  Write the 'tool use' section
steps.annotation: A second in-flight request. Addressing is still by agent name (Codex AgentPath); the id is for the round trip.

steps.content: request root → alice [req_004]  Write the 'approval policy' section
steps.annotation: alice now has two pending requests. Without replyTo, two of her replies would be indistinguishable.

steps.content: response bob → root [final_005] replyTo=req_999  ghost: no such request  → ignored
steps.annotation: Unknown id is dropped — de-dup / cross-talk guard. Codex does not keep this map; the chapter does.
Workers still only have write_file. Protocol dispatch is harness-side, not a new model tool.

steps.content: response alice → root  replyTo=req_002  matched · response bob → root  replyTo=req_003  matched · response alice → root  replyTo=req_004  matched
steps.annotation: Each FINAL_ANSWER-style response is posted by the harness with teaching replyTo. Root ticks the ledger, not the tone of the sentence.

steps.content: broadcast root → alice, bob  all sections in — stand down
steps.annotation: Stand-down is another no-reply broadcast. Claiming work without root assigning it is s17, not a new envelope kind.
